Icon set v2.0-icons

A full redraw in the Spark's language, proposed for approval by code. Nothing in the game changes. Each cell shows the game's current icon (rendered by the real module, at its real size) next to the new one at whole multiples, on paper, leather and the dark flight ground.

The language from spark.svg and trigger-icons.mjs

  • Grid. 16 x 16 pixels. Map stops use 24 x 24 and are shown larger. Whole-pixel rects only, shape-rendering="crispEdges", no gradients, filters or bitmaps.
  • Outline. One dark warm pixel, #2a1d12, on every silhouette. Light from the top left: a pale rim on the lit edges, a darker rim on the shaded edges, plus a 1 px white highlight.
  • Shape. Blunt and stepped. Tips are two pixels wide, never needle points.
  • Sizes. Only 16, 32, 48 (map stops 24, 48, 72). Never fractional.
Spark gold#d39a3aSpark gold#f0c86aCream#f6ebccMoss#536430Wine#7a2f2aLeather#5a4632Night blue-green#42768fOutline#2a1d12

Each tone also has a pale lit rim and a darker shaded rim of the same hue, so a body is three steps, never more.
